note: H154: 3 physical devices, LAN HTTP, no adb reverse. Not iroh. operator=1.

controls.name: three_workers_same_pin
controls.must_fire_because: host-darwin + phone-s25 + phone-s24 each ACCEPT 590d8769 over LAN
controls.can_fail_because: fewer than 3 workers, or any envelope digest != pin
controls.null_must_contain: a worker set that can miss a name or a digest

controls.name: transport_is_lan_not_adb_reverse
controls.must_fire_because: phones dial the LAN address; unauth is 401; bind is not 0.0.0.0
controls.can_fail_because: job_peers include 127.0.0.1, reverse set, unauth != 401, bind 0.0.0.0
controls.null_must_contain: 127.0.0.1 peers, empty reverse list, or HTTP 200 unauth

falsifiers.name: not_three_device_lan
falsifiers.can_fail_because: workers < 3 OR accepted_pin < queued OR phone peer is 127.0.0.1 OR unauth != 401
falsifiers.null_must_contain: worker counts, peer IPs, and HTTP codes that can fail each check
falsifiers.refutes: 3-device LAN run missing a worker, pin, or used adb reverse
falsifiers.fires_when: workers < 3 OR accepted_pin < queued OR phone peer is 127.0.0.1 OR unauth != 401
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

no_deps_reason: live LAN F001 on 3 machines; no elder
falsifier: fewer than 3 workers ACCEPT 590d8769, or a phone peer is 127.0.0.1, or unauth is not 401
